REST response: { license_ids: [A1, A2] }
IF license_ids.length == quantity (2):
    state = Closed Complete
ELSE:
    state = Work in Progress
    note = "only 1 of 2 seats returned"
caption: Closed Complete means the external system confirmed the full quantity.

code:
WRONG:  send REST call -> state = Closed Complete
RIGHT:  send REST call -> wait -> check response -> state
caption: Closing on a sent call, not a confirmed one, is what lets a failed provision silently read as done.
